title: Add __slots__ to a Python data class for memory efficiency
description: Brownfield Python refactor: add __slots__ to a Vector3 class to reduce per-instance memory overhead. All existing tests must continue to pass; the class must no longer have a __dict__ attribute.

injections.content:
from src.vector3 import Vector3
import math


def test_magnitude():
    v = Vector3(1, 2, 2)
    assert v.magnitude() == 3.0


def test_dot_product():
    a = Vector3(1, 0, 0)
    b = Vector3(0, 1, 0)
    assert a.dot(b) == 0.0


def test_add():
    a = Vector3(1, 2, 3)
    b = Vector3(4, 5, 6)
    assert a + b == Vector3(5, 7, 9)


def test_equality():
    assert Vector3(1, 2, 3) == Vector3(1, 2, 3)
    assert Vector3(1, 2, 3) != Vector3(1, 2, 4)

task_spec.prompt:
Add __slots__ to Vector3 in src/vector3.py.

class Vector3:
    __slots__ = ('x', 'y', 'z')

    def __init__(self, x: float, y: float, z: float):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.z = z
    # ... rest unchanged

All 4 original tests must continue to pass.
The solution test file adds a 5th test to verify __slots__ is in effect:

def test_has_slots():
    v = Vector3(1, 2, 3)
    assert hasattr(Vector3, '__slots__')
    assert not hasattr(v, '__dict__')

Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: All original methods (magnitude, dot, __add__, __eq__) still work
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.vector3 import Vector3" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
